title: [Feature]: Any plan to support strix halo gfx1151?
body: A user reported trying RCCL tests on two Strix Halo devices over Thunderbolt, failing to build RCCL after manually adding gfx1151, and asked about support.

comments.author: huanrwan-amd
comments.text: At the moment, we do not have plans to support Strix Halo for RCCL. Please stay tuned for future updates.
comments.status: historical; superseded by later tracking and merged enablement

comments.author: huanrwan-amd
comments.text: Support will be tracked through ROCm/rocm-systems#2788.
